user.title: Connect your MAX! CUL
user.description: Choose how Home Assistant can reach your CUL device.

device_picker.title: Choose a serial CUL
device_picker.description: Select the serial port your CUL is connected to. Choose “Enter manually” if your device is not listed.

manual_device_path.title: Enter a device path
manual_device_path.description: Enter a serial path such as /dev/serial/by-id/your-device, or a telnet URL such as telnet://192.168.1.10:2323.

pick_host.title: Connect over the network
pick_host.description: Enter the host name or IP address of your CUL's telnet server. The default port is 2323.

error.cannot_connect_to_device: Could not communicate with a CUL at this address. Check the path, host, port, permissions, and that the device is powered on.

abort.already_configured: This CUL connection is already configured.

init.title: CUL radio settings
init.description: Set the radio address used by this CUL. Leave the default unless you need a different address.
